Additionally, ECG+ app also provides detailed analysis of heartbeat intervals, including QT/QTc, which is an important indicator of your heart's electrical activity.

HRV refers to the variation in time between successive heartbeats, which is an indicator of the health of the autonomic nervous system. QT interval refers to the time it takes for the heart to recharge between beats, which is important for assessing cardiac health.

With HRV trends you can learn your health level changes. A up hill trend means a better physical fitness level and a down hill indicates you should pay more attention to your overall health. So what is HRV?
HRV is a measure of your autonomic nervous system that is widely considered one of the best objective metrics for physical fitness and determining your body’s readiness to perform.

Although HRV manifests as a function of your heart rate, it actually originates from your nervous system. Your autonomic nervous system, which controls the involuntary aspects of your physiology, has two branches, parasympathetic (deactivating) and sympathetic (activating).

The parasympathetic branch (often referred to as “rest and digest”) handles inputs from internal organs, like digestion or your fingernails and hair growing. It causes a decrease in heart rate. The sympathetic branch (often called “fight or flight”) reflects responses to things like stress and exercise, and increases your heart rate.

Heart rate variability comes from these two competing branches simultaneously sending signals to your heart. If your nervous system is balanced, your heart is constantly being told to beat slower by your parasympathetic system, and beat faster by your sympathetic system. This causes a fluctuation in your heart rate: HRV.

A powerful App to perform real-time Spirometry and (optionally) Oximetry tests directly on your IPhone. A professional App that is easy to use and is ideal for remote patient monitoring and self management of cardiorespiratory medical conditions.
The App is also part of MIR Live Exam system. With a super-fast peer to peer connection, the health care provider can see and coach the patient during the test, while the spirometry and oximetry curves are plotted in real time on his/her computer. A step ahead of the traditional home care solutions where the patient is not supervised during the test.
The App requires MIR Spirobank Smart or MIR Spirobank Oxi Spirometer to be purchased separately. 
The App automatically connects with the Spirometer via Bluetooth Low Energy. 
Spirometry: PEF, FVC, FEV1, FEV1/FVC ratio, FEF25/75, FEV6, VEXT, PEFTIME, FEF75, FEF25, FEF50

The TK-Doc app offers an easy way to contact the TK-MediCall doctors using your smartphone – no matter whether you are after general medical advice on health topics such as diseases, treatments and surgical procedures or whether you need one-on-one remote consultation including a statement of fitness for work. 

The Symptom Checker tool helps you get an idea of what medical conditions you may be dealing with based on the symptoms you enter, while the Lab Result Checker gives you information about many of the results of your blood or urine tests.

For data privacy reasons, this app is only available to TK insurees aged 16 and up.

The TK-Doc app offers the following functions:

• Medical advice: The app provides general answers to your medical questions. You have access to more than 80 doctors who specialise in around 30 different fields of medicine. You can ask your medical question quickly and easily using the live chat, and you can also share documents such as medical reports or prescriptions with the doctor. Alternatively, you can book a video appointment with a doctor and discuss your concerns live in a face-to-face consultation. This function is available Mondays to Fridays from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. You can also get telephone advice round the clock 365 days a year.

• TK-OnlineSprechstunde [TK-OnlineConsultation]: This is the first fully digitised service that focuses exclusively on remote treatment. You can use video telephony to get medical treatment for illnesses such as flu-like infections, back pain and diseases of the upper respiratory tract. The doctors consider each case individually to decide whether your symptoms can be treated remotely. Besides diagnosing your symptoms and recommending suitable treatment, you can also have the doctor issue a statement of fitness for work if necessary.

• Symptom Checker: No matter whether you are running a temperature, have a headache or are suffering from any other symptoms – the Symptom Checker gives you information about the diseases that could be causing your symptoms in no time at all. Just answer a series of questions, and the tool will generate a list of diseases that match your symptoms most closely. This will give you a better idea of your health problems and enable you to prepare for your doctor’s appointment. 

• Lab Result Checker: You can use this self-assessment tool to check whether your lab results are too high or low. It can tell you which medical conditions may be causing abnormal values, which other lab values are important in this context, which measures may have to be taken, and much more. 


We are constantly adding new functions to the TK-Doc app – based on your tips and ideas! You are welcome to send feedback to gesundheitsapps@tk.de. Thank you very much!

Requirements:
• TK insuree
• iOS 13.0 or higher
